title: Apply for and activate DigiD

shortSummary.text: Apply using your registered details, then activate your account with the letter.

whoThisIsFor.text: Students registered at a Dutch address who need online access to public services.

whenYouNeedIt.text: After your BSN and address registration are available.

jurisdiction.note: National rules; local starting points for Leiden students.

prerequisites.text: After your BSN and address registration are available.

requiredDocuments.text: Activation letter, account credentials and phone; follow the instructions for the method you selected.

estimatedTime.value: Within five working days for the letter
estimatedTime.note: DigiD says the letter arrives within five working days.

estimatedCost.note: A separate price statement has not been confirmed in this source set; verify before publication.

numberedSteps.title: Prepare
numberedSteps.body: Have your BSN, registered address and phone ready.

numberedSteps.title: Apply yourself
numberedSteps.body: Open the official application form. Keep the username and password private.

numberedSteps.title: Activate
numberedSteps.body: Use the code from your letter through DigiD’s app or website. DigiD states activation is required within 21 days.

warnings.text: Never give a helper your password or activation code.

commonMistakes.text: Applying is not the same as activating the account.

tips.text: Test access using an official service; keep your login details out of support messages.

checklist.text: Have your BSN, registered address and phone ready.
Open the official application form. Keep the username and password private.
Use the code from your letter through DigiD’s app or website. DigiD states activation is required within 21 days.

faqs.question: No letter?
faqs.answer: Wait five working days, check the registered address and use DigiD’s missing-letter help.

faqs.question: Foreign phone?
faqs.answer: Check whether SMS arrives. DigiD also describes a spoken-code call when SMS fails.

faqs.question: Code expired?
faqs.answer: Follow the activation page: an account not activated within the stated period requires a new application.

emergencyInformation.text: This guide cannot decide your personal case. Use the responsible institution for help.

sections.title: Check before acting
sections.body: Moving again? Confirm your registered address before requesting the letter.

nextActions.text: Test access using an official service; keep your login details out of support messages.
